scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),cp=require('child_process');if(!fs.existsSync('node_modules/vite')){console.log('Installing dependencies...');cp.execSync('npm install --legacy-peer-deps',{stdio:'inherit'});}" && npx vite build && node -e "const fs=require('fs');fs.mkdirSync('athenaa/app/web/static',{recursive:true});fs.rmSync('athenaa/app/web/static/assets',{recursive:true,force:true});fs.cpSync('dist','athenaa/app/web/static',{recursive:true});fs.rmSync('athenaa/app/web/static/assets/aistudio',{recursive:true,force:true});"
